d:
Get ready to be blown away by the powerful beats of "Bullet Video Song '' from the action-packed movie "The Warriorr," starring Ram Pothineni and Krithi Shetty. This high-octane track will leave you craving for more! Sung by Silambarasan TR and Haripriya, this song graces the screen with their magnetic presence. With a melodious composition by DSP and captivating vocals, Aditya Music brings you a visual treat that guarantees to get your heart racing
Song Name: Bullet song
Movie: The Warriorr
Music: Devi Sri Prasad
Singers: Silambarasan TR & Haripriya
Lyrics: Shree Mani (Telugu)
